name: Wizz Air

evidence.claim: One of the strictest airlines in Europe. Bags are checked at the gate as a matter of routine, not just when they look oversized.

allowances.note: Under-seat bag only. No overhead locker unless you buy WIZZ Priority.
WIZZ Priority adds an overhead cabin bag alongside the under-seat item, and gets you on the plane earlier so there is still bin space left.
